title: Oozy Double Fried American Chicken Wrap
description: A savory and silky American dish featuring sour cream and double fried chicken, all wrapped in a ti leaf wrap, perfect for a midnight craving
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a deep frying pan to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a bowl, mix together the onion powder, garlic powder, salt, and pepper.
Toss the chicken breast strips in the bowl to coat with the spice mixture.
Double fry the chicken by frying it for 5 minutes, then letting it rest for 5 minutes, and frying it again for an additional 5 minutes.
While the chicken is resting, cook the crumbled bacon in a pan until crispy.
In a separate bowl, mix together the sour cream and shredded cheddar cheese.
To assemble the wrap, lay a ti leaf flat and spread a quarter of the sour cream mixture down the center of the leaf.
Add a quarter of the double fried chicken on top of the sour cream mixture.
Add a quarter of the crumbled bacon on top of the chicken.
Fold the ti leaf over the filling to form a wrap and repeat with the remaining ingredients.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
